defmodule BlockchainRedirect.SmartContract do
  @moduledoc """
  Smart contract module for handling cross-chain bridge redirects.
  Implements EIP-3722 compliant redirect resolution for blockchain oracles.
  """

  use GenServer
  require Logger

  @allowed_schemes ["https"]
  @default_oracle_domain "oracle.chainbridge.internal"

  defstruct [:contract_address, :chain_id, :redirect_registry, :config]

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(opts) do
    config = load_environment_config()
    state = %__MODULE__{
      contract_address: opts[:contract_address] || "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000",
      chain_id: opts[:chain_id] || 1,
      redirect_registry: %{},
      config: config
    }
    {:ok, state}
  end

  defp load_environment_config do
    %{
      trusted_domains: parse_trusted_domains(),
      max_redirect_depth: String.to_integer(System.get_env("MAX_REDIRECT_DEPTH") || "3"),
      oracle_base_url: System.get_env("ORACLE_BASE_URL") || "https://#{@default_oracle_domain}",
      validation_mode: System.get_env("REDIRECT_VALIDATION_MODE") || "strict"
    }
  end

  defp parse_trusted_domains do
    raw = System.get_env("TRUSTED_ORACLE_DOMAINS") || @default_oracle_domain
    raw
    |> String.split(",")
    |> Enum.map(&String.trim/1)
    |> Enum.reject(&(&1 == ""))
  end

  def handle_call({:resolve_redirect, transaction_hash, callback_url}, _from, state) do
    case validate_and_resolve(callback_url, state) do
      {:ok, resolved_url} ->
        Logger.info("Redirect resolved for tx #{transaction_hash}: #{resolved_url}")
        {:reply, {:ok, resolved_url}, update_registry(state, transaction_hash, resolved_url)}
      {:error, reason} ->
        Logger.warn("Redirect rejected for tx #{transaction_hash}: #{reason}")
        {:reply, {:error, reason}, state}
    end
  end

  def handle_call({:get_redirect, transaction_hash}, _from, state) do
    result = Map.get(state.redirect_registry, transaction_hash)
    {:reply, {:ok, result}, state}
  end

  defp validate_and_resolve(callback_url, state) do
    with {:ok, parsed} <- parse_url(callback_url),
         :ok <- validate_scheme(parsed),
         :ok <- validate_domain(parsed, state.config) do
      {:ok, reconstruct_url(parsed)}
    end
  end

  defp parse_url(url) when is_binary(url) do
    case URI.parse(url) do
      %URI{scheme: nil} -> {:error, :missing_scheme}
      %URI{host: nil} -> {:error, :missing_host}
      parsed -> {:ok, parsed}
    end
  end
  defp parse_url(_), do: {:error, :invalid_url_type}

  defp validate_scheme(%URI{scheme: scheme}) do
    if String.downcase(scheme) in @allowed_schemes do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :invalid_scheme}
    end
  end

  defp validate_domain(%URI{host: host}, config) do
    normalized_host = String.downcase(host)
    case config.validation_mode do
      "strict" ->
        if normalized_host in config.trusted_domains do
          :ok
        else
          {:error, :untrusted_domain}
        end
      "relaxed" ->
        if domain_suffix_match?(normalized_host, config.trusted_domains) do
          :ok
        else
          {:error, :untrusted_domain}
        end
      _ ->
        {:error, :invalid_validation_mode}
    end
  end

  defp domain_suffix_match?(host, trusted_domains) do
    Enum.any?(trusted_domains, fn domain ->
      String.ends_with?(host, domain)
    end)
  end

  defp reconstruct_url(%URI{} = parsed) do
    URI.to_string(parsed)
  end

  defp update_registry(state, transaction_hash, url) do
    %{state | redirect_registry: Map.put(state.redirect_registry, transaction_hash, url)}
  end

  # Public API for Plug/Phoenix integration
  def resolve_oracle_redirect(conn, params) do
    tx_hash = params["tx_hash"]
    callback = params["callback_url"]

    case GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:resolve_redirect, tx_hash, callback}) do
      {:ok, url} ->
        conn
        |> Plug.Conn.put_resp_header("location", url)
        |> Plug.Conn.send_resp(302, "")
      {:error, reason} ->
        conn
        |> Plug.Conn.send_resp(400, "Invalid redirect: #{reason}")
    end
  end
end
